entries.what: Brakes lab at Tamsen Valley College 8-11, then lunch and a drive home in the Tacoma. Evening pickup soccer at Delgado Park.
entries.outcome: Got through the lab with a clean bay; played an hour of soccer.

entries.what: Recorded a few voice-memo flashcards in the truck, then watched engine teardown videos before bed.
entries.outcome: Finished one chapter's worth of memos.

entries.what: Tuesday morning helped Oscar load the generator and griddle gear at the house, then drove to campus for engine performance 1-4 with Salas.
entries.outcome: Salas praised the diagnosis but noted a messy tool tray.

entries.what: Listened to flashcard memos while prepping the griddle at home, then texted Ximena about the weekend.
entries.outcome: Plans for Saturday set at the stand.

entries.what: Brakes lab 8-11 at Tamsen Valley, then filled the Taco at the Ruel Road station, noticing the traffic from Ridgeline's new overtime shifts.
entries.outcome: Spent about $50 on gas, saw trucks backed up on Ruel.

entries.what: Gladys mentioned the candidate forum at the community center where people argue about Ruel Road potholes and warehouses; Rafael skipped it to help prep masa containers for the stand.
Late evening watched a teardown video of a Honda engine.
Engine performance 1-4 with Salas, then lunch with Dante, who pitched buying more auction Civics. Rafael wondered how many cars he could sell before needing a dealer license.
entries.outcome: Said he'd think about it and didn't commit.

entries.what: Asked the assistant whether he needs a dealer license to sell more than a few cars a year.
entries.outcome: Learned it's a real question worth checking before any flip.

entries.what: Thursday stand shift at the Ruel Road lot area running the griddle, with setup and teardown of canopy and generator.
entries.outcome: Steady sales; Gladys logged them in the green notebook.

entries.what: Morning brakes review, then fixed a loose battery terminal on the Taco before the afternoon.
Evening at the Ruel Road stand. At 8:50 he left to pick up Dulce from Taquería Colima and got back by 9:20.
entries.outcome: Dulce home safe; stand covered meanwhile.

entries.what: Saturday stand shift with Ximena helping. Gladys worried about the lot after dark.
Midday bought pork for chicharrón from Chuy at Ruiz Family Market for the family.
Sunday errands in the morning and a quiet breakfast with his parents. Oscar and Gladys talked about the week's sales.
entries.outcome: Sales looked decent for the new lot.

entries.what: Sunday evening stand shift 5-10 p.m., then voice-memo flashcards while breaking down the canopy.
